abstract: Diesel/gasoil exports jump by 12% month-on-month in early June
Exports of fuel oil have surged to highest since February 2022

stories.title: SBB’s Teetering Empire Triggers Calls for Public Intervention
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: During the era of low interest rates, Swedish landlord SBB built itself into a $13 billion behemoth by taking on cheap debt to snap up schools and health-care centers that local governments were looking to offload. Now, the company at the center of the country’s real estate crisis is facing off against local councils that want their properties back.
abstract: Landlord’s $8 billion debt pile backed by schools, hospitals
Parliament debating whether state should buy back properties

stories.title: European Stocks Post Best Week Since April Amid Luxury Rally
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: European shares rose on Friday, posting their biggest weekly advance since April, buoyed by gains in the luxury goods and utilities sectors.

stories.title: Nikkei 225 Rises for 10th Week in Longest Streak in a Decade
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: The Nikkei 225 ended higher for 10th straight week in its longest streak since February 2013 after the Bank of Japan kept its easy monetary policy, causing the yen to weaken.

stories.title: Amanat Hires FAB, EFG for Healthcare IPO in Abu Dhabi
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: Amanat Holdings PJSC, a Dubai-based health care and education investment firm, has picked EFG Hermes and First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC to manage the planned initial public offering of its health care unit in Abu Dhabi, according to people familiar with the matter.
abstract: Healthcare IPO could raise about $200 million later this year
Persian Gulf IPO boom has slowed this year on lower oil prices

stories.title: Barclays Shuffles Investment Bank Ranks, Hires for Industrials
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: Barclays Plc has filled several senior jobs at its investment bank as it works to stem attrition of US staff following leadership changes.

stories.title: Entain Shareholder Eminence Calls STS Deal Funding ‘Illogical’
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: Entain Plc, the London-listed gaming company that operates Ladbrokes, is being criticized by a shareholder for its “illogical” decision to fund its acquisition of STS Holding SA with an equity sale.

stories.title: Hungary’s Orban Becomes Chief Marketer of EMEA’s Best Bonds
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: Prime Minister Viktor Orban is intensifying efforts to get Hungarians to put their savings in government bonds rather than bank deposits, appealing to their patriotism while pledging to “crush” inflation.
abstract: Orban is cajoling savers to move funds into government notes
Premier also reaffirms vow to ‘crush’ inflation in Hungary

stories.title: Australian Home Rents Higher Than Advertised Prices, Study Finds
stories.autoGeneratedSummary: Australia’s home-rental inflation is accelerating, with prices agreed between tenants and landlords typically higher than the advertised rate, a joint research paper from the Reserve Bank and the Australian Bureau of Statistics showed.
